title: kbs show and detail panel display the right-now line
description:
As a Kanbus user I want the right-now summary on kbs show and the issue detail panel so I do not have to open the feed to see current status.

Feature: Issue display

  Scenario: Show issue includes right-now summary
    When I run kanbus show
    Then stdout contains Right now: and the summary or (no right-now summary)
right_now_summary: The team is adding the right-now summary to kbs show and the issue detail panel.
